name: hud_sensor_tracker_update_map_scale_lerp
description: HudSensorTracker::UpdateMapScaleLerp advances the active map-scale interpolation, clamps at completion, and updates the current scale vector from start/goal values.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x416be0 has no direct callees; it returns 1, skips field changes when mapScaleLerpRunning is zero, otherwise adds mapScaleLerpStep to mapScaleLerpT, clamps T to 1.0 and clears mapScaleLerpRunning when T reaches or exceeds 1.0, then linearly interpolates mapScaleCurrent from mapScaleStart to mapScaleGoal.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x416be0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same tracker-field-only update.

The native smoke verifies the inactive no-op path, an in-progress update from T=0.25 to T=0.75 with interpolated xyz values, and the completion path that clears the running flag, clamps T to 1.0, and reaches the goal vector.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x416be0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
